description: Chromium crash survival (F12 chromium arm), one launch per run: SIGKILL by exact child pid of the tab's renderer, the GPU process and the network service utility, and chrome://crash and chrome://gpucrash typed in the omnibar, while a terminal beside the page is typed into. survived/cases per launch (a case it could not measure counts as not survived; .measured says how many were), the kill to the page answering again, and terminal key->frame after each kill. The in-process browser CHECK is reported expected-fail until F2. Both cefHelperHost arms run: each launch's own tunables file sets the feature's local override browserHost.helper to its arm (LaunchIdentity strips an inherited CMUX_ENABLE_FEATURES), and features.list reports it with source local, so each arm's results carry its features.
